item.text:
Created a complete Rust 2021 project in `/output` with the root entry file [test20.rs](/output/test20.rs), manifest [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), and modular library code in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs), and [src/model.rs](/output/src/model.rs). The implementation matches the observed C++ program contract from `std::env::args()`: default `complexity = 3`, upper clamp at `5`, `std::stoi`-style prefix parsing on `argv[1]`, ignored extra args, and matching abort behavior for invalid and out-of-range input.

I built it with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition=2021 test20.rs -o test20`. Executables are available at [test20](/output/test20) and [target/release/test20](/output/target/release/test20). I verified behavior against `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable` for the default case, `0..6`, negative input, `+2`, `2abc`, `1.5`, `0x10`, invalid input, and overflow; the checked stdout, stderr, and exit codes matched.
